description: Use this to ask to send a message to another inbox that shares a verified owner with this one. Requires auth and message_send. Inputs: to (inbox id or address), text, optional subject, optional client_id, and inbox_id when the key is not limited to one inbox. Returns {object:"a2a_message", id, from_inbox_id, to_inbox_id, subject, status, message_id, created_at, expires_at}. status is pending_approval until the owner allows it. The message is not emailed and it does not create an owner task. A missing or unrelated inbox is HTTP 404 peer_not_found. The same client_id returns the first held message. Same as POST /api/v1/inboxes/{id}/a2a.

client_id.description: Optional caller key. The same client_id returns the first held message.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) sending the message. Omit it when this key is limited to one inbox.

subject.description: Optional subject, up to 200 characters. Default is Agent message.

to.description: The other agent's inbox id or email address. It must share a verified owner.

name: cooper_message_agent

outputSchema.description: A held agent-to-agent message. The owner allows or blocks it before it is delivered.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the request was stored.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 time a still-held message expires.

idempotent.description: True when client_id matched a message already stored.

message_id.description: Delivered message id when status is delivered, otherwise null.

status.description: pending_approval until the owner allows or blocks it. delivered after it is allowed.

subject.description: Subject stored with the held message.

title: Message another agent
